**Thursday**, with Tae Kwon Do at 4:00. It is Gear Week, so arrive already in full gear. **Friday** brings Crochet Club after school.

Tech week rehearsals start **Monday** and take three afternoons in a row. Tonight, pick the subject you would least like to meet at 9 pm next Tuesday and give it twenty minutes now. Future you, covered in stage dust, will not write a thank-you note, but will be grateful.
